Bill.BriefDescription: Revising provisions concerning juvenile truancy proceedings.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to juvenile truancy proceedings; and adding newsections to chapter 28A.225 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.225RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Whenever a juvenile fails to appear for a scheduled court hearingunder RCW 28A.225.035 and the court issues a bench warrant as a result,the court shall also appoint an attorney to represent the juvenile ifone has not already been appointed.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.225RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except for RCW 28A.225.030(5), the court may order that noticerequired under this chapter be provided by means other than personalservice but only if personal service has been attempted but has beenunsuccessful, and service has then been attempted by certified mail butreturned as unclaimed and the court bases its decision on documents orother information indicating that an alternative form of service is p. 1 SSB 6600more likely than not to reach the person to be notified. For purposesof this section, "alternative form of service" means certified mail,return receipt requested, or regular mail.
